name: Vadosfa (Hungary)
description: Two equal vertical stripes of green and yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Vadosfa: a crowned green shield with a yellow trefoil, a sabre and a bunch of grapes, with a Luther rose crest, above a green scroll inscribed VADOSFA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Vadosfa arms with crown, crest and scroll
